_comment: Models for parts whose own are not the ones to draw (docs/modding.md, models.json): a part's full id, or the start of
one ending in *, to a KN5 under this folder. The source game's coil springs are small for the cars of the day: they
are drawn with running_gear/coil_springs (tools/RunningGearParts/prepare_standins.py, credited beside it).
